name: elagoht/jsonld
description: A collage plugin that emits schema.org structured data into the document head.

config.description: A collage plugin that emits schema.org structured data into the document head.

disabled.description: Disabled turns structured data off without removing the plugin from the application: the site-wide node is not declared, and every Emit in the render returns without doing anything.

searchURL.description: SearchURL is a search endpoint with "{query}" where the term goes. It is part of the WebSite node, and ignored without SiteName.

siteName.description: SiteName names the site. When it is set, a WebSite node is declared on every page — as a default, which a page emitting its own WebSite replaces. Its url is the application's origin, collage.BaseURL, and is left out when the application has none.
